title: Information Estimation with Discrete Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.23404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. translated_title: 基于离散扩散的信息量估计
translated_abstract: 互信息等信息论度量在理解随机变量之间的非线性关系方面发挥着关键作用，并被广泛应用于各个科学学科。然而，它们在现实世界离散数据上的应用仍然充满挑战。现有方法通常依赖于将离散数据嵌入到连续空间中，然后应用最初为连续分布设计的神经估计器。这一过程需要对嵌入模型和估计器架构进行精心的工程设计，且饱受高数据维度相关问题的困扰。在本工作中，我们提出了InfoSEDD，一种基于离散扩散的方法，它将信息论估计与生成建模相连接，使其能够用于计算Kullback-Leibler散度。在连续时间马尔可夫链理论原理的支持下，InfoSEDD的设计轻量且可扩展，并能够与预训练模型无缝集成（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了基于离散扩散的InfoSEDD方法，将信息论估计与生成建模相结合，为离散数据的互信息等信息度量估计提供了一种轻量且可扩展的新途径。
en_tdlr: InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach, bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling, providing a lightweight and scalable way to estimate mutual information on discrete data.
